content.value: Waves having a wave period of 10 sec and wave height of 3 m break on a (10) quartz sand beach with median grain size (D50=.2mm). Assume a median grain size D50 corresponding to a density of 2650 kg/m³, k coefficient=0.23, k=1.0 and sediment falling velocity =0.03 m/sec for this problem. Calculate volumetric cross-shore sand transport rates in a beach with 3 percent beach slope and water depth of 5 m.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2014
